headline: A fresh dispatch from the server room
body:
The library now has 119 movies, 7 series, and 8 episodes. This week: 3 new movie or series additions.

Arty's observation: The projectionist is doing splendidly, despite the utterly unreasonable infrastructure involved in a modest film night.
new_titles: The 100 Year-Old Man Who Climbed Out the Window and Disappeared
